blind.description: No text or labels are visible in any of the renders. The model depicts an asymmetric gothic skeletal archway consisting of a tall square pillar on the left and a descending curved archway on the right. The tall pillar features a moulded plinth base, recessed gothic tracery panels, a sculpted human skull beneath the capital, and a pyramidal cap with four golden corner finials/spikes. The arch curves downward from near the top of the pillar to a low moulded plinth resting flat on the ground; it is composed of interlocking vertebrae-like bone segments, each topped with a small golden candle-like point. Geometry is solid, continuous, and manifold with clean edges and bevels; there are no broken shards, spikes, blobs, holes, or floating flakes. Nothing is hovering unattached or melted/fused. It stands on its own integral architectural plinths which sit completely flat on the floor, with no added terrain slab or external base. Materials are stylized hand-painted weathered bone and stone (off-white/pale grey) with charcoal grey recessed paneling and muted gold accents; dark areas are intentionally textured stone, not raw unpainted mesh. There is no emission, flame, or glow.
blind.from_above: From straight above (tile C), the structure is completely linear along a single axis. On the left is the square top of the tall pillar with an X-shaped hipped roof and four corner accents. Extending to the right is the narrow straight ridge of the archway showing dorsal vertebral crests flanked by golden points, terminating at the stepped rectangular top of the lower plinth.
blind.height_vs_figure: The tall pillar stands approximately 6.5 to 7 feet tall (about 1 foot taller than the 5 ft 9 in scale figure), while the entire archway spans roughly 10 feet wide (spanning two 5-ft grid squares, nearly 1.7 to 1.8 times the height of the figure). The lower right plinth is approximately 1 to 1.5 feet tall.
